SELECT s.store_id, s.store_key, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, s.open_date, s.close_date, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current,

   OR s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure)
ORDER BY s.store_id, s.valid_from

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
per_store AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) AS wks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT t.store_id, t.store_name, t.region, t.wks AS ty_wks, l.wks AS ly_wks, t.net_sales AS ty, l.net_sales AS ly, ROUND(100*(t.net_sales/l.net_sales-1),2) AS g
FROM per_store t JOIN per_store l ON l.store_id=t.store_id AND l.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
WHERE t.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
ORDER BY t.region, t.store_id

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year FROM dim_date
  WHERE (fiscal_year='FY2025/26' OR fiscal_year='FY2024/25') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
),
mine AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, s.store_id, d.business_date, SUM(d.v) AS v FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  ) d JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=d.store_key JOIN rng r ON r.calendar_date=d.business_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, c.store_id, c.business_date, c.net_sales AS v FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN rng r ON r.calendar_date=c.business_date WHERE c.store_id<900
),
dups AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS dup_rows FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) AS fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id,
       count(*) AS days, round(sum(coalesce(m.v,0)),2) AS mine, round(sum(coalesce(c.v,0)),2) AS ctl, round(sum(coalesce(m.v,0)-coalesce(c.v,0)),2) AS diff,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(m.v,0)-coalesce(c.v,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_days, (SELECT dup_rows FROM dups) AS dup_keys
FROM mine m FULL OUTER JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id AND c.business_date=m.business_date
GROUP BY 1,2
HAVING abs(sum(coalesce(m.v,0)-coalesce(c.v,0)))>0.05 OR sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(m.v,0)-coalesce(c.v,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0
ORDER BY 1,2

UNION ALL SELECT 'savonlinna_sales_last_days_'||CAST(f.sale_date AS VARCHAR), count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=129 AND f.sale_date>='2026-01-19' GROUP BY f.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_in_closed_store_weeks_'||CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR), count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN ref_store_closure c ON c.store_id=s.store_id AND f.sale_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date GROUP BY s.store_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_before_open_'||CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR), count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.open_date IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date < s.open_date GROUP BY s.store_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'physical_stores_current', count(*) FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores_with_sales_no_dim_ver', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_regions_'||string_agg(DISTINCT region, ','), 0 FROM dim_store WHERE is_current
UNION ALL SELECT 'ty_trading_day_false_in_range_' || CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), 0 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND NOT is_trading_day
UNION ALL SELECT 'ly_trading_day_false_in_range_' || CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), 0 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND NOT is_trading_day

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) AS n, min(sale_date) AS dt, min(store_key) AS sk, sum(net_amount) - min(net_amount) AS extra_net
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_week, s.store_id, count(*) AS dup_keys, round(sum(extra_net),2) AS extra_net, min(d.dt) AS first_dt, max(d.dt) AS last_dt
FROM d JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date=d.dt JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=d.sk
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS sale_days, (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date x WHERE x.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND x.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND x.is_trading_day) AS trading_days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1,2
HAVING count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) <> (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date x WHERE x.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND x.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND x.is_trading_day)

),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       ty.net_sales AS ty_net, ly.net_sales AS ly_net
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region
